title: How to clean a hairbrush

pieces.say: Your hairbrush is way dirtier than you think.
pieces.text: Your hairbrush is way dirtier than you think.
pieces.label: YOU'RE DOING IT WRONG

pieces.say: Here's the fix. A comb and a shampoo soak.
Rake the hair out with a comb.
Dip the bristles in warm water with a drop of shampoo.
Scrub the base with an old toothbrush.
Rinse, then dry it bristles down.
Wooden or cushioned brush? Don't soak it, just dip and wipe.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
